yaskkserv_bin.description: The type of the yaskkserv daemon binary (hairy, normal, or simple).

yaskkserv_mode.description: The mode variable name for DAEMON_OPTS (e.g., HAIRY_OPTS, NORMAL_OPTS, SIMPLE_OPTS).

yaskkserv_max_connection.description: Maximum number of connections for the server.

yaskkserv_port.description: The port number the server listens on.

yaskkserv_completion_midasi_length.description: Length of the server completion midasi buffer.

yaskkserv_completion_midasi_string_size.description: Size of the server completion midasi string buffer.

yaskkserv_google_japanese_input.description: Google Japanese Input setting (disable, notfound-input-suggest, etc.).

yaskkserv_google_japanese_input_timeout.description: Timeout for Google Japanese Input in seconds.

yaskkserv_local_dics.description: Custom local dictionary paths, one per line, for LOCAL_DICS.

yaskkserv_pkg_dics_default.description: Default package dictionary entry for PKG_DICS.

yaskkserv_pkg_dics_extra.description: Additional commented-out dictionary options from the default config, preserved verbatim.
